description: This file is a shell script used for testing core Git commands, such as update-index, ls-files, cat-file, diff-files, write-tree, checkout-index, read-tree, and various configuration and repository state checks. It includes setup procedures, test expectations, and command invocations to verify Git's internal functionalities in different scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution with specific commands.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes lines of text to a file.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares file contents or output against expected results.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to execute after tests.
